g.text: Limits: NASA-STD-3001 Vol. 2 Rev. A, Figs 2–5 (sustained, > 0.5 s); in (a) solid = abort/emergency entry, dashed = nominal return. (b) Time each simulated entry
of the entry-simulation figure spends above a given load; T-10-1: reported 14–17 g for about 5 s.
